text: So we have a Django REST API running in production on AWS.
It handles about 5000 requests per minute during peak hours.
Recently the p99 latency jumped from 200 milliseconds to 4 seconds.
The database CPU is sitting at 95 percent constantly.
We also see connection pool timeouts in the application logs.
How would you go about debugging and fixing this?
